package.name: l8_foxglove_demo
package.description: ENPM818Z Lecture 8 reading, Foxglove: the L2 bridge, foxglove_bridge and a node that publishes every car's true box and its constant-velocity prediction, 5 s ahead, with the speeds and a warning when a prediction comes close to the AV's own. A Foxglove layout shows them next to the camera and the LiDAR.
